newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine peso closes weak on arbitrage play.
newsitem.headline: Philippine peso closes weak on arbitrage play.

text.p: The Philippine peso finished weak on Friday at 26.369 from 26.355 as it was pulled down by arbitrage play for the weekend, dealers said.
Banks usually sell dollars Friday and buy them back for delivery on Monday to have the pesos for placements during the weekend.
Volume was light at $81.5 million from $90.5 million since most dealers left early for a weekend convention.
In late trade, traders said they saw the Central Bank intervene by selling about $13 million at 26.37.
"It could be an outflow...a requirement from a foreign fund," a dealer said.
On Monday, the peso will be dictated by the results of the regular weekly Treasury bill auction, dealers said.
They expect T-bill rates to edge higher after rallying for two consecutive weeks.
"Banks will await that before positioning further on the peso," a big bank dealer said.
